verdict.rationale: Attio has an optional Deal object, a reporting engine with line/bar charts and pipeline metrics (win rate, sales cycle, stage conversion), custom fields, and SQL queries over workspace data. A founder could plausibly assemble a forecast from these pieces, but nothing documents revenue forecasting itself. Missing for 10: a native forecasting feature, stage-probability weighting, close-date-based projections, an evidenced pipeline-value roll-up, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
